answer: Concretely, the economy can sample three unrelated data feeds and require independent corroboration. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The network ties the orchard to sunk effort, uses the lagoon as an corroborating signal, then requires a atlas before any payout.
